evidence.detail: Exact-v308 class extends rs/cache/e, implements Runnable, owns request queues, CRC32, socket/input/output state, version/index arrays and the on-demand fetch/retry/read loop.

The run loop performs check/failed/request/read stages, retries incomplete requests after loop-cycle thresholds, resets stalled sockets, validates CRC/version trailers and writes completed files into cache stores.
Classic 317 OnDemandFetcher source matches the same superclass, Runnable role, request-loop structure, CRC check, socket state and OnDemandData queues.

proposals.note: Name is strongly fixed by exact algorithm and historical lineage.

evidence.detail: Exact-v308 node stores request data type/id, payload buffer, incomplete/priority state, loop-cycle counter and additional request metadata; constructor defaults the request-state booleans.
OnDemandFetcher queues, retries, fills and completes these nodes by matching their type/id and writing received bytes into the node buffer.
Classic 317 client source names the structurally identical node OnDemandData with fields dataType, ID, buffer, incomplete and loopCycle.

proposals.note: Pinned SpawnPK v308 behavior is primary authority; historical client source corroborates the inherited identity.

Exact-v308 OnDemandFetcher extends this class directly.
